citation: Carvalho G, Guilhen C, Balestrino D, Forestier C, Mathias JD. Relating switching rates between normal and persister cells to substrate and antibiotic concentrations. Microb Biotechnol. 2017;10(6):1616-1627.
licence_verified: Europe PMC core record, license field, checked live
contents: Supplementary information and figure files for a two-state persistence model of Klebsiella pneumoniae CH1440 under ciprofloxacin.
why: A second, independent two-state model with calibration data, from a laboratory unconnected to the one under audit. It also relates switching rates to SUBSTRATE concentration, which is the nutrient axis exp14 measures, and it fills the Klebsiella cell that docs/12 records as empty.
note: Openly licensed; retained in this repository with attribution.
